states.name: main
states.eval: document.querySelectorAll('#dc-root div[role="group"]').forEach(g => { [...g.children].forEach(c => { const t = c.textContent.trim(); if (t.startsWith('Stufe ') && !t.includes(':')) c.remove(); else if (c.getAttribute('aria-hidden') === 'true') c.remove(); else if (c.tagName === 'A' || (c.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').length > 0) c.remove(); }); });
